entities.name: Modar Bejiri
entities.description: A vedalken court hussar promoted to field hussar in the last days of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Doppelganger
entities.description: An unnamed-murderer doppelganger who kills Modar and takes his shape.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Azorius soldiers who arrive to make the arrest.

entities.name: Tin Street Market
entities.description: Market where Modar staged his search.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The fraying pact binding Ravnica's guilds.

events.summary: On his first day in the field Modar encounters a doppelganger who just committed murder but cannot arrest it.
events.quote: Modar encountered a doppelganger who had just committed murder

events.summary: Modar requests an emergency writ of arrest for a hussar officer, himself.
events.quote: Modor Bejiri requested an emergency writ of arrest for the capture of a Hussar officer.

events.summary: Modar lets the doppelganger kill him in Tin Street Market; it takes his shape just as Azorius soldiers arrive to arrest it.
events.quote: Modar let himself be killed by the creature who then took on his shape.

relations.quote: Just in time for the arresting Azorius soldiers to arrive.

relations.note: Killed him and took his shape
relations.quote: Modar let himself be killed by the creature who then took on his shape.
